rationale: The stock gapped down ~16% on an earnings miss and has been recovering through the session, now sitting at 81.5% of today's range near $73.32 with only 43 minutes to close. The wide bid-ask spread (45 bps) and the position near the upper end of the day's range after a large gap-down create unfavorable risk/reward for either direction — a long risks reversal from resistance near today's high ($74.89) with limited time, while a short risks continued momentum squeeze into close. With an existing correlated long position (TEAM) already on and today's realized P&L negative, the prudent action is to avoid adding exposure in a volatile, post-earnings name this late in the session.
